item.title: How Colom Changed a Long Shot in Mississippi Into a Race Too Close to Call
item.description: Scott Colom, a Democrat, ran a viral ad and courted Republicans at a Trump rally before winning virtually the same number of votes as Senator Cindy Hyde-Smith, a Republican.
item.dc:creator: John Yoon and Jim Beaugez
item.media:description: Scott Colom, a Democrat running for Senate in Mississippi, greeting supporters in Jackson, the state capital, on Wednesday.

item.title: How Trump Is Reacting to the Midterm Results
item.description: In the days after Republicans suffered massive midterm election defeats, President Trump appeared unmoved. The New York Times’s White House correspondent Maggie Haberman explains how Trump’s public demeanor compares with what he has shared behind closed doors about voters’ frustration with some of his policies.

item.title: Justice Alito Will Not Retire From Supreme Court Immediately, Despite Election Outcome
